first_missing_authority_owned_runtime_ev.description: Authority-owned visibility of the exact current browser registration / Receipt #1 and the same-nonce runtime event before Gateway or Master Records evidence can be evaluated.
first_missing_authority_owned_runtime_ev.reason_first: The existing browser executor directly reads the StegOS Node registration from IndexedDB and cannot construct the later exact runtime/custody tuple without that authentic registration and event. Gateway advertisement is downstream.

gadi_current_iphone_receipt_readback.why_not_receipt_1: It validates SV-NODE resident-rendezvous observation/digests, not stegos.node_handoff_receipt.v1 and does not supply the exact browser registration interlock/device-binding genesis tuple.

historical_stegos_node.why_not_current_a1: Historical first-node evidence is not the exact current immutable invocation registration/runtime event.

service_gateway_observation.why_not_first: A verified provider-neutral Gateway advertisement is required only after the browser has an authentic same-invocation runtime/custody receipt to submit.

cmc029_public_webpki.role: Only applicable to a chosen public browser-trusted HTTPS candidate when needed.

already_repaired_native_dispatcher_seam.meaning: The dispatcher no longer strips an already-present Receipt #1 locator. This does not materialize browser IndexedDB Receipt #1 into a host file or prove A1.

next_evidence_boundary: First seek the existing browser executor's authentic registration + same-nonce RUNTIME_READY_FOR_WORKERCOORDINATOR event. If the originating browser context is not directly observable, consume only an already-authentic StegOS #347 governed recovery result containing the exact retained genesis Receipt #1; do not make #351 mandatory or synthesize recovery. Only after that exact A1/A2 tuple exists proceed to verified provider-neutral Gateway advertisement and canonical Master Records custody.
